name: Reimbursify vs Mentaya
title: Reimbursify vs Mentaya: OON Claims Platforms Compared
description: Compare Reimbursify (per-claim pricing, mobile app) vs Mentaya (free for therapists, 5% client fee, 100% refund guarantee). Two approaches to out-of-network claims.

summary.bottom_line: Both platforms help with OON claims but have different models. Reimbursify offers both patient and practitioner pricing ($3.99/claim for patients, $59-99/mo for providers) with mobile apps. Mentaya is completely free for therapists with clients paying 5% per claim and a 100% refund guarantee. Choose based on who you want to pay - and whether you want a mobile app.

rows.entity_a: Yes - patients can file own claims

sections.heading: Two OON Approaches
sections.content: Reimbursify and Mentaya both eliminate superbills for out-of-network claims, but with different models. Reimbursify is unique in offering direct-to-patient pricing - patients can file their own claims via mobile app for $3.99 each. Mentaya is therapist-initiated with a 5% client fee and 100% refund guarantee if claims fail. Both platforms handle the complexity of OON billing.

sections.heading: Economic Comparison
sections.content: For a $200 session: Reimbursify costs patients $3.99 per claim. Mentaya costs clients 5% = $10. So Reimbursify is cheaper per claim for higher-fee sessions. However, Mentaya's 100% refund guarantee reduces risk, and therapists can absorb the 5% to offer free claims. Reimbursify's Plus ($59/mo) and Pro ($99/mo) plans include benefits verification and API access.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: Reimbursify's standout is the mobile app - patients can snap superbill photos and file claims themselves. It also covers non-therapy services (PT, acupuncture, chiropractic). Mentaya's standout is the refund guarantee and automatic denial appeals. Mentaya integrates with SimplePractice and Jane App; Reimbursify doesn't have EHR integrations but offers API access.

recommendations.when: You want patients to handle their own claims, or you prefer per-claim pricing over percentage-based fees.
You want zero therapist cost with a 100% refund guarantee and automatic denial handling.
You also treat PT, acupuncture, or chiropractic patients (broader specialty support).
You use SimplePractice or Jane App and want integrated claims submission.

faqs.q: Which is cheaper - Reimbursify or Mentaya?
faqs.a: Depends on session fees. Reimbursify: $3.99/claim fixed. Mentaya: 5% of claim (e.g., $10 on $200). For sessions over ~$80, Reimbursify is cheaper per claim. But Mentaya offers a refund guarantee.

faqs.q: Can patients file their own claims with Mentaya?
faqs.a: No, Mentaya is therapist-initiated. With Reimbursify, patients can download the app and file their own claims using superbills.
Mentaya guarantees 100% refund of fees if they can't successfully submit a claim. They also handle denials and resubmissions at no extra cost. Reimbursify doesn't offer equivalent protection.
Mentaya integrates with SimplePractice and Jane App. Reimbursify doesn't have EHR integrations but offers API access on the Pro plan ($99/mo).
